title: Dances he created: Peace Time Hop, Jeep, Palsy Walk
summary: He describes dances he invented after World War II and in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Lee, didn't you also invent a few dances?

Well, yes, shortly after the Second World War, well I created a dance called the Peace Time Hop. The reason I called it the Peace Time Hop, going from wartime to peace, I thought it would be very appropriate at that time to call it Peace Time Hop, which became very popular in the East Coast and in the West.

Well, the Jeep is a dance that I did when I was peering in Chicago, so long around there. And also another dance that I did in Chicago during that time called the Palsy Walk, which was quite the thing in Chicago.
What was the, excuse me for interrupting, what was the Jeep live, Suzy?
Well, it was something on the order of the Suzy Q and trucking, and same way by the palsy, only you would shake your head and shake all over, it's like you had the palsy.
